summary: Selected only Pro Proposal 5, the sole cross-review survivor for a bounded test. Emitted a fixed-target rank-72 lattice in dimension 154 for the nine-clause four-variable edge-cover formula: 72 selector anchors, 41 raw normalization/legality/occurrence-consistency checks, and all 41 cyclic base-33 radix residuals. Canonical column HNF checks the embedded lattice. The exact unrestricted squared CVP minimum is 80 versus Boolean completeness squared radius 72. A signed selector has zero raw and radix residual: for global marginals 0000, clause 0 replaces forbidden 000 by 011 + 100 - 111, while all other clauses are honest one-hot blocks. Thus the radix mutation is killed on this finite instance.
hypothesis: Causal mechanism: cyclic superincreasing base-33 orders should make every bounded nonzero residual expensive because each check is the leading digit in one order. Expected move: every unrestricted vector for the unsatisfiable nine-clause instance lies beyond the Boolean completeness scale due to a nonzero raw/radix residual. Falsification condition: an integral signed-selector vector satisfying normalization, legality, and occurrence consistency exactly, since every radix coordinate then vanishes. The verifier finds such a vector at squared distance 80, only 8 above the 72 anchor baseline.

tests.finding: Verified the emitted 154-dimensional basis and single target, matching canonical column HNF hash 0119d79d11831422315b0b60c635d9b50ae8b888bd0dcfd88729cbc24004a271. next_experiment: Do not continue this linear radix mutation: exact affine selector kernels are invisible to every residual weighting. A fresh proposal must first encode a polynomial-size lattice mechanism that excludes the local identity 011 + 100 - 111 = 000 at equal normalization and marginals; before any amplification claim, test its actual fixed-target basis by unrestricted exact CVP on this nine-clause obstruction and a satisfiable multi-assignment control.
